summary: Iteration 5 frontend testing (backend skipped as instructed). All new sections + flows verified end-to-end on preview URL: cookie consent (first-visit banner, accept persists to localStorage, decline persists, banner suppressed after reload), privacy modal (opens via cookie-policy-link with editable policy text), News section (4 mosaic cards, card 0 large), Video section (feature-video element with correct pexels .mp4 src, poster, muted property, mute toggle wired via IntersectionObserver — headless codec limitation acknowledged, not reported as bug), Publications (3 cards with buy buttons, checkout modal with prototype-note amber panel, all three close paths — cancel/pay/x — work; pay is MOCKED prototype toast as intended), Navbar Kabar link present (nav-link-news), EN toggle switches labels (KABAR→NEWS, BELI AKSES→BUY ACCESS). CMS editor: admin login OK, Editor Website tab shows sidebar items '07 — Kabar / News', '08 — Video', '09 — Publikasi Ilmiah', 'Privasi & Cookie'. Edited policyText textarea with unique marker → Simpan → landing privacy modal shows updated text. Then editor-reset-btn confirmed via dialog → landing privacy modal reverts to default Indonesian policy text (marker absent, default length >100). Regression: hero + join form still render.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoFeature.js: video element uses `muted={muted}` React prop — muted attribute is not rendered when state flips to false; property works correctly for autoplay policy so functionally fine, but noting that in test we saw `hasMutedAttr:false, muted:true` which is React-controlled behavior (not a bug).
CookieConsent.js: localStorage key 'gesoi_cookie_consent' is only read on mount — if user rejects/accepts in another tab, current tab won't sync. Minor, unlikely to matter for landing.
Publications checkout is intentionally mocked (per spec) — pay button just fires toast; consider a data-testid on toast for future automated verification, or hook Stripe when ready.
News.js large card class uses `md:row-span-2` but grid has `md:auto-rows-fr` which flattens rows — visual mosaic works but only because card 0 has taller min-height. Acceptable.
Privacy modal text uses whitespace-pre-line — good; but no rich formatting. If content grows, consider markdown rendering.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set site_content.privacy.policyText via CMS to 'TEST_PRIVACY_MARKER_XYZ_2026...' then Reset via editor-reset-btn. Verified reset cleared marker; landing shows default policy again. localStorage keys used during test: gesoi_cookie_consent (accepted/declined) — cleared each phase.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 fully verified. All new sections (News, Video, Publications) render with correct testids. Checkout is intentionally mocked (toast only, no API call). Cookie consent + privacy modal work; CMS-driven privacy text update propagates to landing. Content reset to defaults after test — landing shows default Indonesian policy. Video autoplay decoding failure in headless is a known browser codec limitation, NOT a code bug.
